fact: Momentum Works estimates 2025 regional platform food-delivery GMV at US$22.7 billion, up 18% year on year; ShopeeFood exceeded foodpanda in GMV.
status: Published research estimate; 2025 observations, not 2026 actuals
reviewScope: Public report announcement reviewed; paid country tables not accessed
gotoLesson: Analyst interpretation: compare affordability, order frequency and merchant-ad economics; do not apply a regional GMV ranking as Indonesia market share.

fact: Grab announced an agreement to acquire foodpanda Taiwan for US$600 million cash, on a cash-free and debt-free basis, subject to adjustments and approvals.
status: Agreement announced; this review does not establish subsequent closing
gotoLesson: Analyst interpretation: assess acquisition-led entry, integration costs, merchant retention and regulatory hurdles before importing regional expansion assumptions.

fact: foodpanda announced restaurant and meal discovery through ChatGPT and Claude; customers follow a link to the foodpanda app or website to order and pay.
status: Company-announced Singapore availability; no independently measured conversion uplift
gotoLesson: Analyst interpretation: test conversational GoFood discovery with accurate menus, location, budget and dietary filters; measure referral conversion and acquisition cost.

fact: Grab announced definitive agreements for a controlling 60% interest in Atome Financial for US$1.49 billion cash, including US$260 million of primary growth capital.
status: Proposed transaction; expected Phase 1 completion Q3 2027, subject to approvals and conditions
reviewScope: Original issuer announcement and transaction terms reviewed
gotoLesson: Analyst interpretation: monitor merchant distribution, underwriting and cross-sell against GoPay lending. Acquisition consideration, growth capital and total valuation must remain separate.

fact: The authorities signed an MoU to strengthen cooperation and explore interoperability for QR-based cross-border payments.
status: MoU and cooperation agenda; not evidence of a live interoperable consumer-payment launch
gotoLesson: Analyst interpretation: track technical implementation, merchant acceptance, participating providers and settlement/FX economics before assigning GoPay volume.

fact: OJK revoked this specific finance company’s business license under decree KEP-57/D.06/2026, effective on the decree date.
status: Revoked; exact Indonesian legal entity only
reviewScope: Original Indonesian notice, dated release and later English page reconciled
gotoLesson: Analyst interpretation: monitor legal-entity-specific lender and partner licenses. Do not attribute this revocation to every Credit Saison group business or infer a GoTo exposure.

fact: Grab announced a Thailand AI training programme targeting more than 3,000 driver, delivery and merchant partners.
status: Training target; not a verified completed-training count or earnings uplift
gotoLesson: Analyst interpretation: compare partner training plus in-app tools, using completion, active use and measured merchant/driver outcomes rather than enrolment targets.
